services.name: 3D Scanning
services.tagline: Capture any part, product or space as an accurate digital model.
services.intro: We scan parts of every size with a range of professional 3D scanners — from small precision components to car bodies and full buildings. The result is a precise digital copy of the physical object, ready for product design, reverse engineering and quality control.
points: High-accuracy capture
Blue-laser and structured-light scanners record detail down to hundredths of a millimetre.
Any size, on site or in-house
From jewellery to vehicles and plant rooms — we bring the scanner to you when the part can't travel.
Clean, usable data
Scans are aligned, cleaned and merged into watertight meshes, not raw point dumps.
Ready for the next step
Data is prepared for reverse engineering, inspection, printing or visualisation.

services.name: Reverse Engineering
services.tagline: Turn scan data into fully editable, manufacturable CAD.
services.intro: We rebuild physical parts as parametric CAD models — for re-manufacturing legacy parts with no drawings, modifying existing designs, or creating moulds and tooling. You choose how faithful the model should be to the scanned part.
points: Design-intent modelling
A clean CAD model with manufacturing imperfections removed — ideal for re-manufacture from 3D models or 2D drawings.
NURBS surface models
Precise freeform surfaces fitted over scan data where an exact as-is representation matters.
Hybrid modelling
Prismatic features modelled to design intent, freeform areas surfaced to the scan — the best of both.
Drawings on request
2D manufacturing drawings with GD&T generated from the final model.

services.name: Scan to BIM
services.tagline: Existing buildings captured as accurate, intelligent BIM models.
services.intro: We laser-scan existing structures and convert the point cloud into detailed BIM models. Architects, engineers and contractors get an accurate as-built foundation for renovation, retrofit and facility-management projects — with every wall, slab, column and service documented.
points: As-built accuracy
Terrestrial laser scanning records the true geometry of the building, not the original drawings.
LOD 200–400 models
Walls, floors, structure and MEP modelled to the level of detail your project needs.
Clash-ready coordination
Models are set up for coordination with new design work in Revit and Navisworks.
Drawings from the model
Floor plans, sections and elevations exported straight from the BIM.

services.name: Class A Surfacing
services.tagline: Flawless, curvature-continuous surfaces for visible parts.
services.intro: Class A surfaces are the visible skins of a product — car body panels, aircraft fairings, consumer-product housings. We build G2/G3-continuous surfaces with clean patch layouts and verify them with zebra and curvature analysis, so reflections flow without a ripple.
points: G2 / G3 continuity
Curvature-continuous transitions between every patch for perfect reflections.
Analysis-verified
Zebra stripes, highlight lines and curvature combs checked on every surface.
From scan or sketch
Start from a clay-model scan, a reference surface or concept sketches.
Tooling-ready
Surfaces handed over with draft, flanges and offsets ready for engineering.

services.name: Digital Metrology
services.tagline: Compare manufactured parts to their CAD — to the micron.
services.intro: We inspect manufactured parts by scanning them and comparing the result against the nominal CAD. Colour deviation maps, GD&T checks and first-article reports show exactly where a part is in or out of tolerance — fast, and without contact.
points: Colour deviation maps
Full-surface comparison against CAD, instantly showing where material is over or under.
GD&T inspection
Flatness, position, profile and more, measured and reported against the drawing.
First-article inspection
Complete FAI reports for new parts, tools and suppliers.
Trend analysis
Repeated inspections track tool wear and process drift over time.

services.name: 3D Printing
services.tagline: Rapid prototypes and functional parts, straight from your model.
services.intro: We print prototypes, fit-check models, jigs, fixtures and short-run end-use parts directly from CAD or scan data. Our team also prepares and repairs files — including sculpted character models — so they print right the first time.
points: Rapid prototyping
Physical parts in days to check form, fit and function before tooling.
Functional materials
Engineering plastics and resins chosen for strength, heat or detail.
Print-ready preparation
Mesh repair, hollowing, supports and orientation handled for you.
Character & figure models
Digitally sculpted busts and figures prepared for high-detail resin printing.

services.name: Product Rendering
services.tagline: Photoreal visuals that sell a product before it is ever made.
services.intro: We turn CAD and design models into photorealistic images and animations for marketing, presentations and design reviews. Materials, lighting and scenes are tuned so your product looks real — and looks its best — before the first unit is built.
points: Photoreal stills
Studio and lifestyle shots with accurate materials, finishes and lighting.
Animations & turntables
Exploded views, assembly sequences and 360° spins.
Interiors & exhibitions
Spaces, stands and environments visualised before construction.
Jewellery visualisation
Metals and gemstones rendered with true reflections and sparkle.

industries.name: Aerospace
industries.line: Inspection and reverse engineering of high-precision aircraft components.
industries.intro: Aerospace parts leave no room for error. We scan, inspect and reverse-engineer turbine components, brackets, ducts and fairings — with the documentation and accuracy the sector demands.

industries.name: Automobile
industries.line: Body surfacing, part digitising and fixture design for vehicles.
industries.intro: From cylinder heads to bumpers and bike frames, we digitise vehicle parts, rebuild them as CAD, create Class A body surfaces and inspect production parts against design.

industries.name: Construction
industries.line: As-built scanning and BIM models for buildings and sites.
industries.intro: We capture existing buildings and sites as accurate point clouds and BIM models, and visualise spaces before they are built — so renovation and design start from reality.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.line: Medical devices and custom-fit parts captured and modelled in 3D.
industries.intro: We scan and model medical devices, wearables and custom-fit products such as eyewear and orthotics, and prototype them quickly for testing and approval.

industries.name: Education
industries.line: Scanning and 3D printing support for labs, research and teaching.
industries.intro: Universities, labs and schools use our scanning, modelling and printing for research projects, teaching aids and digitising collections.

industries.name: Jewellery
industries.line: Fine-detail scanning and printing for jewellery design and casting.
industries.intro: We capture fine jewellery detail, prepare models for casting and printing, and produce photoreal renders that sell pieces before they are made.
